title: What does elyrac AI actually do?
text: We build fully customized AI software systems for businesses. Unlike AI tool resellers or consultancies, we write actual code — building AI pipelines, training models on your data, integrating with your existing systems, and deploying production-ready software that your team uses every day.

title: How do I know if AI is right for my business?
text: If your team is doing repetitive, data-heavy tasks — reading documents, writing similar emails, analyzing reports, answering the same questions — there's almost certainly an AI solution that saves significant time and cost. Book a free call and we'll give you an honest assessment.

title: What's the first step to work with you?
text: Book a free 30-minute strategy call. We'll listen to your business challenge, assess technical feasibility, and give you honest feedback on what's achievable — including realistic timelines and cost ranges. No sales pitch, no commitment required.

title: How long does a project typically take?
text: Most projects take 4–12 weeks depending on complexity. Simple automations can be live in 3–4 weeks. Complex multi-system AI platforms may take 3–4 months. We agree on a clear timeline in the scoping phase before any work begins.

title: How involved does my team need to be?
text: We handle all the technical work, but we need your input to do it right. Expect 2–3 hours per week for feedback, domain knowledge sharing, and review sessions. We work iteratively, so your team sees progress weekly — not just at the end.

title: What if my requirements change mid-project?
text: We plan for this. We use an iterative delivery model where we check in weekly and adjust based on what we learn. Small scope changes are absorbed; significant pivots are re-scoped with transparent communication about impact on timeline and cost.

title: Do you work with our existing data and systems?
text: Always. We integrate with your databases, CRMs, ERPs, email systems, APIs, and internal tools. We never ask you to change how you work — we make AI work within your existing stack. Data security and compliance are handled from day one.

title: Do you use OpenAI / ChatGPT, or build custom models?
text: Both, depending on what's right for your use case. We leverage OpenAI, Anthropic, and other leading models when they're the best fit — and build custom or fine-tuned models when the task requires domain-specific accuracy or data privacy constraints.

title: How do you handle data privacy and security?
text: We follow security best practices: data minimization, encrypted storage and transmission, access controls, and deployment in your own cloud environment when required. For regulated industries (healthcare, finance, legal), we design with specific compliance requirements in mind.

title: What technologies do you use?
text: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, React, Flutter, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, TypeScript, Redis, and more. We choose the right tool for your specific use case — not whatever's trendiest at the moment.

title: How much does a project cost?
text: Projects are scoped and priced individually based on complexity and timeline. Simple automations start from a few thousand dollars. Complex AI platforms range significantly higher. We provide detailed, fixed-price proposals after the discovery phase — no hidden fees.

title: Do you offer ongoing support after launch?
text: Yes. We offer monthly retainer plans for monitoring, maintenance, and iteration. Most clients keep us on retainer because the first project reveals more opportunities — and we know the system better than anyone.

title: Who owns the code and AI models built?
text: You do — completely. All code, models, and IP are transferred to you at project completion. We never retain rights to anything we build for you, and we don't use your data or models for other clients.

title: How long does it take to build a custom AI system?
text: Most projects are delivered in 4–12 weeks depending on complexity. We define a clear timeline during our strategy session before any work begins, so you always know exactly when to expect delivery.

title: Do I need to understand AI to work with you?
text: Not at all. Most of our clients come to us with a business problem, not a technical brief. Our job is to translate your challenge into the right AI solution — you just need to understand your business. We handle the rest.

title: Will the AI system connect with our existing tools?
text: Yes — always. We build systems that integrate with your existing CRMs, ERPs, databases, and internal tools. We never ask you to change how your business works. We make AI fit around your current stack.

title: What happens after the system is delivered?
text: We train your team, monitor the system, and remain available for support and iteration. Most clients stay with us on a retainer because the first project always reveals more opportunities — and we know the system inside out.

title: How do I know this will actually return value for my business?
text: We run an AI audit of your business before recommending anything. We only proceed when there's a clear, measurable outcome — like hours saved, revenue increased, or costs reduced. If we don't believe it will return value, we'll tell you honestly.

title: How much does a custom AI system cost?
text: Every project is scoped individually because every business is different. The best way to get a clear number is to book a free 30-minute strategy call — we'll assess your challenge and give you a realistic picture of cost and timeline, no commitment required.

title: Intelligent Email Agent for ioTec Ltd
text: CHALLENGE: The team was spending 4+ hours daily on email triage, categorization, and drafting responses to routine enquiries. The inbox had become a bottleneck, slowing down sales and support cycles. SOLUTION: We built a custom AI email agent that reads incoming emails, categorizes them by intent, drafts appropriate responses, and escalates complex cases to the right team member — fully integrated with their existing inbox. RESULT: 80% of routine emails are now handled autonomously. The team reclaimed 3+ hours daily, response times dropped from hours to minutes, and customer satisfaction improved significantly.

title: AttendTrack — Workforce Management System
text: CHALLENGE: Manual attendance tracking and zero visibility into field worker locations. HR teams relied on spreadsheets and guesswork, causing payroll errors and no accountability for field teams. SOLUTION: We engineered a full workforce management platform with AI-powered attendance tracking, real-time GPS geofencing for field agents, automated payroll calculation (NSSF, PAYE), and an integrated AI Copilot powered by Claude Sonnet that answers HR questions in natural language. RESULT: 100% attendance accuracy. 3 hours saved daily on HR admin. Full real-time visibility across every field team. Payroll errors eliminated completely.

title: Code Clinic — Healthcare Practice Management
text: CHALLENGE: A growing dental and general practice was running on fragmented tools with no unified system. Patient records, appointments, billing, and staff management were all handled separately with no real-time visibility. SOLUTION: We built a comprehensive clinic management platform covering patient records, live appointment scheduling, real-time patient flow tracking, invoicing, payroll, staff management, and a full analytics dashboard — all in one system. RESULT: 24 appointments managed daily with full visibility. Revenue tracked in real-time (UGX 31.2M monthly). 790 active patients managed seamlessly. Admin workload reduced by 60%.

title: WinoPay — Full-Stack Fintech Platform
text: CHALLENGE: Building a production-grade financial platform from scratch demands the highest standards of security, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. The client needed a complete system handling real-money transactions across multiple services with zero tolerance for errors. SOLUTION: As Lead Engineer, we owned the full system architecture end-to-end — backend API design, database structure, transaction processing logic, and the complete security layer including audit logging, role-based access control, and encryption. The platform integrates flights, hotels, bill pay, insurance, and retail — all processing real financial transactions with live users. RESULT: A fully operational fintech platform serving live users with real payment transactions. Meets the same data integrity and compliance standards required by regulated financial institutions. Zero critical transaction failures since launch.

title: Trivox AI — Intelligent Dental Receptionist
text: CHALLENGE: Dental clinics were losing patients due to missed calls, slow booking responses, and overwhelmed front desk staff. After-hours enquiries went completely unanswered, directly impacting new patient acquisition and revenue. SOLUTION: We built Trivox AI — a fully conversational AI receptionist trained on dental clinic workflows. It handles appointment booking, patient enquiries, follow-up reminders, and proactive outreach 24/7. Fully integrated with the clinic's existing calendar and patient management systems. RESULT: +40% more bookings captured. 24/7 availability with zero missed outreaches. Front desk workload cut in half, freeing staff to focus entirely on in-clinic patient care quality.

title: AI/ML Fraud Detection — Financial Services
text: CHALLENGE: Financial institutions face growing fraud risk as transaction volumes outpace human review capacity. Legacy rule-based systems generated too many false positives while missing sophisticated emerging fraud patterns — a compliance and financial liability risk. SOLUTION: We engineered a purpose-built ML fraud detection pipeline — data ingestion from transaction systems, feature engineering, model training and evaluation, and real-time inference integration. The system identifies anomalous transactional behaviour with high precision, generates compliance alerts with full explanations, and maintains a complete audit trail of every detection event for regulatory review. RESULT: Real-time fraud detection at transaction scale. Full audit trail for regulatory compliance. Significant reduction in false positives. The model continuously improves as new transaction data flows in.

title: Women Microfinance Initiative — Soroti, Uganda
text: CHALLENGE: A Uganda-based NGO running a microfinance program for women entrepreneurs in Soroti had no digital system. Member records, loan tracking, and financial reporting were entirely paper-based — slow, error-prone, and unscalable. SOLUTION: We developed a purpose-built cooperative financial management system covering member profiles, loan applications and approvals, repayment schedules with automated tracking, overdue alerts, and instant financial reporting — designed specifically for grassroots microfinance operations. RESULT: Fully digitized operations for the cooperative. Loan repayment tracking fully automated. Financial reports now generated in seconds. Program administrators freed from manual record-keeping to focus on community impact.
